title: Potsdam in Winter - Quick Summary
items: **The winter season runs from 1 November to 31 March.** Most Potsdam palaces shorten their hours, and many close until spring.
**Open all winter:** Sanssouci Palace (Tuesday to Sunday) and the New Palace, both **10:00 to 16:30**, last entry 16:00.
**The New Palace is a German-language guided tour in winter.** It closes on Tuesdays until December and on **Mondays from January 2027**.
**From January, no Potsdam palace interior opens on a Monday.** The park stays open and free to walk.
**Weekends only:** the Marble House, the Church of Peace (until 14 March), the Historic Windmill (not in December) and the Belvedere on Pfingstberg (November and March).

**Closed until spring:** the Chinese House, Picture Gallery and Charlottenhof until May, the New Chambers until April. Cecilienhof, the Orangery, the Roman Baths and Babelsberg Palace are closed for restoration.
**The sanssouci+ day ticket costs 22 euros** and beats two single tickets at 14 euros each when both big palaces are open.
**My move:** go on a weekend, walk the park in daylight, book the Sanssouci slot for the afternoon and end at the Christmas market from 23 November.
